experience.title: Senior AI/ML & Data Engineer
bullets: Build full-stack and AI capabilities across Amazon Connect, spanning Customer Profiles (one view of a caller, assembled from the systems a business already runs), Contact Lens (conversation analytics), Amazon Q in Connect (agent assist) and Forecasting.

Owned the real-time path that turns a live conversation into something an agent can act on mid-call - transcript, intent and suggested answer landing while the customer is still talking - on a service carrying support traffic for many of the country's largest brands.

Delivered the supervisor side of the product, replacing spreadsheet staffing with forecasts a workforce manager can argue with - the reasoning is visible, and every plan it produces can be overridden line by line by the person accountable for the week.

Rebuilt caller authentication so a returning customer is recognized from how they speak rather than from a quiz, with an explicit fallback whenever confidence is low and a durable record of why each decision went the way it did.
